title: Accept raster slides and sandbox interactive HTML
preconditions: Have small valid PNG, JPEG and WebP files, plus self-contained HTML that changes its own DOM and attempts parent document access.

steps.action: Create a separate slide for each raster file using its explicit media type and open each slide.
steps.expected_result: Each raster slide is accepted and displays its image.

steps.action: Add and open the HTML slide.
steps.expected_result: Its content runs inside the sandboxed slide; it cannot access the parent document or remove the sandbox.

expected_result: Its content runs inside the sandboxed slide; it cannot access the parent document or remove the sandbox.
